We need to determine crimes. Two sets of facts:

1. Theft of communication cables: multiple thefts of telecom cables, value amounts. This is theft (盗窃) of property. Possibly "盗窃" or "抢夺"? He cut cables, took them. That's theft. Could be "盗窃" (theft) or "破坏财物"? He also damaged telecom infrastructure. Could be "破坏电信设施罪" (damage to telecom facilities). In Chinese criminal law, cutting telecom cables is a crime of "破坏电信设施罪" (Article 111 of Criminal Law). Also theft of cables is theft. Usually they charge both theft and damage. In examples, similar case: "盗窃;非法狩猎" for stealing trees. So multiple crimes separated by semicolon. So we likely list "盗窃" and "破坏电信设施". The second fact: escape from prison (脱逃) while serving sentence. That's "逃狱罪" (escape from custody). In Chinese law, "逃狱罪" is under "逃脱罪"? Actually "逃狱罪" is under Article 311? It's "逃脱罪" (逃脱罪). So crime: "逃脱罪" (escape from prison). Could be "逃狱". So we have three crimes: theft, damage to telecom facilities, escape from prison.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃;破坏电信设施;逃脱<eoa>
